column1: # BEADS_RUST conformance cases: name<TAB>args (space-separated; empty for none)<TAB>stdin file (optional)
# One row per behavior the spec numbers. Cover every class before Phase 3:
#   happy path (each command / mode)        edge (empty input, one element, max size)
#   error (bad input → message + exit code)  usage (no args, extra args, bad flag value, unknown command)
#   missing file / unreadable                unicode / long lines / trailing newline variants
#   determinism (the same case twice under different names is allowed)
# Names are identifiers (they become file names). Paths are relative to the
# directory conform.sh runs from (the project root).
